description: Read source: a whole file by path, a line window (start_line/end_line, no size cap unless max_lines is set), a declaration by name (symbol_locator; Go and Python resolve natively, other languages through the language server), or several of those at once with targets. Responses carry the content, the document revision and the line count; a multi-target reply lists every target's size under entries before the bodies. max_lines caps a delivery and the reply says truncated with the total, so read a big file with max_lines or view=outline first, then window what matters. Experimental: max_bytes bounds each source selection, including a single minified line; byte_offset and expected_revision_id continue that same selection safely. Offsets count UTF-8 bytes after line selection and numbering; retain the same target/options on continuation. Outline/history views do not accept byte windows.

byte_offset.description: Zero-based byte offset into the same selected/rendered source. Nonzero offsets require expected_revision_id. Use returned next_byte_offset to preserve UTF-8 characters.

expected_revision_id.description: Document revision from the preceding read; a changed document refuses continuation instead of mixing versions.

limit.description: history and changes views: number of entries.

max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 content bytes per source target, including numbering. Metadata/JSON escaping are additional. Explicit opt-in; compact mode defaults to 65536. Does not bound acquisition memory.

max_lines.description: Deliver at most this many lines per source target; a capped reply says truncated and reports the total line count.

numbered.description: Prefix each line with its number and a tab.

plan_id.description: Plan whose prepared revision to answer about, as an alternative to naming the revision.

plan_revision.description: Expected plan revision; a preparation replaced since is refused rather than answered.

response_format.description: both preserves text and structured payloads; text omits their duplicate structured copy; structured returns structured data with a short text receipt. Overrides the response_mode transport default.

response_mode.description: compact returns one text payload by default, concise edit receipts, and read source windows of 64 KiB unless max_bytes is supplied. full preserves the existing response. Refusal and verification information is retained.

revision.description: Prepared revision (prep_...) to answer about; omit, or pass current, for the canonical workspace.

root.description: Project root; opens or reuses its workspace when workspace_id is omitted.

after_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bounded following anchor.

before_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bounded preceding anchor.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact selected bytes.

name_path.description: Declaration name path: Name, Parent/Name, Parent.Name, Parent::Name or, for Go methods, (*Parent).Name; all are normalised to Parent/Name.

path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute text file path.

targets.description: Several reads in one call: each item names a path with optional view/start_line/end_line/max_lines/numbered, or a symbol_locator. Every option of a single-target read applies per target, so one call can outline one file and window another.

byte_offset.description: Zero-based byte offset into the same selected/rendered source. Nonzero offsets require expected_revision_id. Use returned next_byte_offset to preserve UTF-8 characters.

expected_revision_id.description: Document revision from the preceding read; a changed document refuses continuation instead of mixing versions.

max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 content bytes per source target, including numbering. Metadata/JSON escaping are additional. Explicit opt-in; compact mode defaults to 65536. Does not bound acquisition memory.

max_lines.description: Cap for this target; overrides the call-level max_lines.

numbered.description: Prefix each line with its number; overrides the call-level numbered.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID from workspace_open; or omit it and pass root.

name: read
